gloss: to have influence; to have connections

definitions.gloss: to have influence; to be well connected in a particular place
definitions.explanation: To be known and trusted somewhere well enough that one's word gets things done — a table found at a full restaurant, a favor granted. Literally 'one's face works.' The place or circle is marked with で.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{顔|かお}が{利|き}く。
examples.english: My father has connections in this town.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{顔|かお}が{利|き}く⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}して→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧みよう。
examples.english: He has pull in the industry, so let's ask him about it.

examples.japanese: {顔|かお}が{利|き}く⟦{知|し}り{合|あ}い→知り合い：03253_shiriai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦{満席|まんせき}→満席：07585_manseki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}れ→入る：00494_hairu⟧た。
examples.english: Thanks to a well-connected acquaintance, we got into a restaurant that was fully booked.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{商売|しょうばい}→商売：03239_shoubai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧してきた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{市場|いちば}→市場：01803_ichiba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{顔|かお}が{利|き}く。
examples.english: Having run a business locally for many years, he still has pull at the market.

notes:
STRUCTURE: ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ (face, reputation) + ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ + ⟦{利|き}く→利く：11845_kiku⟧ (to be effective).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{顔|かお}が{利|き}く: to have pull in ~ (a town, an industry, a company)
- {顔|かお}が{利|き}く⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: someone with connections

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{顔|かお}が{広|ひろ}い→顔が広い：06887_kaogahiroi⟧: to know a lot of people — breadth of acquaintance; {顔|かお}が{利|き}く adds the power to get results
- コネ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have connections — plainer and slightly negative, suggesting unfair advantage

USAGE:
Normally admiring, but depending on context it can hint that the person gets special treatment others don't.
